name: Balsamiq
description: Balsamiq is a low-fidelity wireframing and prototyping tool that keeps teams focused on structure and functionality rather than visual polish, with an AI mode that generates prototypes from prompts or screenshots.
best_for: Product managers, founders, consultants, and enterprise teams who want to rapidly sketch and align on interface structure before investing in high-fidelity design.
features: Low-fidelity wireframing UI kit designed to avoid premature visual polish
Balsamiq AI generates interactive prototypes from text prompts or uploaded screenshots
Built-in commenting for real-time team alignment
Confluence and Jira plugins for embedding wireframes
MCP server integration with Claude, Cursor, and Linear
Native desktop apps for Mac and Windows plus a cloud version
SOC 2 Type II certified with GDPR/CCPA compliance
